Title: NETMESSAGE:Please.\nDo not fall in the water.

NETMESSAGE:Objective:
Escort the Engineer to Disarm the Bombs.
Note:
Do not let the barrels be breaked.
Translation:
目标：
护送工程师拆除炸弹。
注意：
不要让桶被破坏。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Objective:
Disable the Mortars on the Upper Street.
Note:
Escort the engineer near the mortars to place bombs.
Translation:
目标：
解除上街的迫击炮。
注意：
护送工程师靠近迫击炮以放置炸弹。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Mission Failed.\nA Biohazard Drum has been broken.
Translation: 任务失败。\n一个生化危险桶已被破坏。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Objective:
Destroy the Rocket Turrets.
Note:
Use the RPG near the last biohazard drum.
Translation:
目标：
摧毁火箭炮塔。
注意：
在最后一个生化危险桶附近使用RPG。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Objective:\nProceed to the Mosque for debrief.
Translation: 目标：\n前往清真寺汇报情况。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Mission Successfully Accompilshed.\nAll Terrorist Threat has been Neutralized.
Translation: 任务成功完成。\n所有恐怖威胁已被消除。
